descriptionEn: A plot of 71 ares is offered for sale, located in Miradi e Epërme, Fushë Kosovë, in an industrial zone with high development potential.
The plot offers the possibility of building an industrial facility, warehouse/logistics or multifunctional business premises, according to the project one wishes to carry out.
The size of the plot allows the development of projects with a variety of uses. The plot has close access to the main roads and full infrastructure, including road, electricity, water and sewerage.
It comes with an ownership certificate and the purchase contract is signed at the notary.
The plot is located in a developed industrial zone of Fushë Kosovë, with close access to the main companies and industrial infrastructure, offering high investment potential and growth in value.
